name: ppap-packets
description: Check a PPAP package before it goes to the customer: match the submission index, pasted evidence, drawing revision and customer checklist into an element-by-element status matrix with stale revisions, wrong part numbers, gaps and reviewer questions. Reconciles ballooned drawing characteristics against dimensional results per cavity, recomputes out-of-tolerance values, capability and gauge R&R, and traces special characteristics from drawing and SCCAF through PFMEA to control plan. Built-in Ford profile (PPAP requirements effective 15 June 2026); other customers use the checklist you paste. For supplier-quality and APQP engineers and PPAP coordinators.
